== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Dance of a Burning World is an Aetheric [[sword]] art and combat style currently mastered by [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]. This [[technique]] is centered on the universal principle of entropy, requiring the practitioner to embrace the reality that the world is in a constant state of [[destruction]]. When utilized, the art manifests as intense red or scarlet flames and light that can ignite the void or extend for vast distances, including across hundreds of miles of space. The power of the art is capable of devouring opposing attacks, slicing through massive entities like a Calamity, and even cutting through entire systems. While [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] can wield the art with his [[force-blade]] or through short-range weapons, performing it on a massive [[scale]] requires the strength of a [[Divine Titan]].}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Knight utilizes a specialized [[technique]] known as the Dance of a Burning World. This method involves igniting a blade of crimson flame around [[Raion Raithe|Raion]]'s [[sword]] to facilitate combat. While the [[technique]] is optimized for performing large, wide-area attacks, it requires the user to possess the knowledge that everything around them is being destroyed.}}
